title: Record an optional baseline floor on the cap trace
action: Let a cap record an OPTIONAL baseline floor: what the SAME verify command did on the base commit (D5). Two touch points, both mirroring shapes that already exist. (1) finish_support.rs: REPORT_OPTIONAL_KEYS is today ["mistakes"] — add the floor as a SECOND optional report key, validated the same way mistakes is: present-but-malformed refuses by name, absent records nothing and is never read as a negative. Its value carries at least the base commit it was measured on and the result the command produced there; keep the shape minimal and structured, not prose. (2) trace.rs: add the field to default_trace() beside verification_evidence / verify_output / verify_passed / verify_command, and ALSO add it to the key list in release_trace(), because it is verify evidence and must not survive a release into a re-claimed cell — that list is exactly where the other four are cleared. STRICT PROHIBITIONS, each load-bearing: do NOT touch parse_tests_proof (finish_support.rs:91-123) — not its signature, not its two-separator split, not its blindness to the result vocabulary; its own comment records that tightening there retroactively refuses ~200 historical caps carrying a bare green, and D3 forbids it. Do NOT add a fourth proof-string segment. Do NOT add a refusal anywhere for a MISSING floor — not in the cap, not in feature_proof_check, not in any close or merge door (D2, D4); absent is legal and silent. Author tests covering: a cap with a well-formed floor records it on the trace; a cap with NO floor succeeds unchanged and leaves the field null; a malformed floor refuses by name; release_trace clears the field; and a pre-existing cap whose report has no such key still parses.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee cells

truths: A cap may carry a baseline floor and it lands on the trace as structured data
